name: Register a new account through the sign-up form and sign in
step_description: Open http://localhost/ in a browser and click the flip text under the login box to open the registration form.
description: Registers a fresh user from the gateway UI and checks the duplicate-name path. Needs the full docker-compose stack and the browser network tab.

step_description: Enter a new username of 3 to 20 characters (for example qa-<today>) and a password of at least 6 characters and submit the form.
The e-mail form appears. In the network tab POST accounts/ returned HTTP 200 with name equal to the username and saving amount 0, currency USD, interest 0, deposit false, capitalization false.
Skip the e-mail form
test_type: log out with the logout button
product_areas: flip to the registration form again and submit the same username and password.

step_description: An alert "Sorry, account with the same name already exists." is shown and the network tab shows HTTP 400 from accounts/.

name: Save incomes and expenses and verify the statistics datapoint
step_description: Sign in at http://localhost/ as a user with an existing account and open the settings page with the plus button.
description: Checks the account save through the dashboard and the datapoint that account-service pushes to statistics-service.

step_description: Add an income titled Salary of 9100 USD per MONTH and an expense titled Grocery of 10 USD per DAY, type a note and press the Save button.
The save animation runs and GET http://localhost/accounts/current with the Bearer token from localStorage returns the two items and the note.
Call GET http://localhost/statistics/current with the same Bearer token.
The response contains a datapoint whose id.date is today, with an income metric titled Salary and an expense metric titled Grocery.

name: Account save keeps working while statistics-service is stopped
step_description: Run docker-compose stop statistics-service and wait until http://localhost:8761 no longer lists STATISTICS-SERVICE.
description: Regression check of the Hystrix fallback added in commit a8bf0f6: an outage of statistics-service must not fail PUT /accounts/current.

step_description: PUT http://localhost/accounts/current with a Bearer token and a valid account body (incomes
The response is HTTP 200, GET /accounts/current shows the changes, and docker-compose logs account-service contains "Error during update statistics for account".
Run docker-compose start statistics-service, wait until the Eureka dashboard shows it UP, and repeat the PUT.
GET http://localhost/statistics/current now returns a datapoint dated today.

name: Password grant token and /uaa/users/current
step_description: POST http://localhost/uaa/oauth/token with header Authorization: Basic YnJvd3Nlcjo= and form fields grant_type=password, scope=ui, username=<user>, password=<password>.
description: Checks the OAuth2 password grant for the browser client and the user-info endpoint used by the resource services.

step_description: HTTP 200 with access_token, token_type bearer and scope ui.
Repeat the token call with a wrong password.
HTTP 400 with error invalid_grant and no access_token in the body.
GET http://localhost/uaa/users/current with the Bearer token from step 2 returns a JSON body whose name is <user>; the same call without the header returns HTTP 401.

name: Config server authentication and health endpoint
step_description: GET http://localhost:8888/actuator/health with no credentials (port 8888 is published by docker-compose.dev.yml).
description: Checks SecurityConfig of the config server: open health endpoint for the Docker healthcheck and HTTP Basic for configuration.

step_description: HTTP 200 and body {"status":"UP"}.
GET http://localhost:8888/notification-service/default with no credentials, then again with basic auth user / the CONFIG_SERVICE_PASSWORD value from .env.
The first call returns HTTP 401; the second returns HTTP 200 and the JSON contains remind.cron and backup.cron.

name: Datapoint normalisation to USD per day
step_description: Point rates.url in config/src/main/resources/shared/statistics-service.yml at a stub that answers GET /latest?base=USD with base USD and rates EUR 0.8 and RUB 80, then restart config and statistics-service.
description: Verifies the currency and period normalisation of StatisticsServiceImpl with the same figures as StatisticsServiceImplTest and the one-datapoint-per-day rule.

step_description: Obtain a server-scope token (client account-service, grant client_credentials) and PUT http://localhost/statistics/qa-norm with incomes Salary 9100 USD MONTH, expenses Grocery 500 RUB DAY and Vacation 3400 EUR YEAR, saving 1000 EUR.
GET http://localhost/statistics/qa-norm returns one datapoint with Salary 298.9802, Grocery 6.25, Vacation 11.6361 and statistics INCOMES_AMOUNT 298.9802, EXPENSES_AMOUNT 17.8861, SAVING_AMOUNT 1250.
Change Grocery to 1000 RUB per DAY and PUT the body again on the same day.
GET http://localhost/statistics/qa-norm still returns exactly one datapoint for today and Grocery is now 12.5.

name: Notification settings save and validation
step_description: PUT http://localhost/notifications/recipients/current with a Bearer token and body {"email":"qa@example.com","scheduledNotifications":{"REMIND":{"active":true,"frequency":"MONTHLY"}}}.
description: Checks RecipientController save and read for the current user and the e-mail validation on Recipient.

step_description: HTTP 200, accountName equals the token's user and REMIND.lastNotified is within one minute of now.
GET http://localhost/notifications/recipients/current with the same token.
The email qa@example.com, active true and frequency MONTHLY are returned.
A PUT with "email":"not-an-email" returns HTTP 400, and a following GET still shows qa@example.com.

name: Gateway routes and ignored services and header forwarding
step_description: Open http://localhost/ and confirm the login page renders with no 404 in the browser console.
description: Regression check of shared/gateway.yml: serviceId routes with the Authorization header forwarded and zuul.ignoredServices set to '*'.

step_description: GET http://localhost/accounts/current with a Bearer token, then the same URL without the Authorization header.
HTTP 200 with the token and HTTP 401 without it.
GET http://localhost/registry/ and GET http://localhost/monitoring/ both return HTTP 404.

name: Juice Shop customer login and wrong password
step_description: Open the portal, go to /#/login, enter a registered e-mail with the correct password and click Log in.
description: Checks the Juice Shop login page against the documented behaviour of POST /rest/user/login. Scan-only repository; not checked against a clone.

step_description: POST /rest/user/login returns HTTP 200 with authentication.token and the header shows the account menu instead of the Login button.
Log out, return to /#/login and enter the same e-mail with a wrong password.
The page shows "Invalid email or password." and the request returned HTTP 401.
